knowledge.title: Alcohol Volume Conversion Rules
knowledge.text:
### RAG-001: Alcohol Volume Conversion Rules
This section defines the standard volumetric measurements for all inventory calculations.

*   **Standard Spirit Bottle:** 700ml
*   **House Pouring Brands (Well Drinks):** 1000ml (1L)
*   **Standard Wine Bottle:** 750ml
*   **Standard Shot:** 60ml
*   **Standard Chaser:** 30ml
*   **Standard Beer Keg:** 30,000ml (30L) - Yields approximately 90 x 330ml servings.
*   **Large Beer Keg:** 50,000ml (50L) - Yields approximately 150 x 330ml servings.

---

knowledge.title: Bartender Jargon & Slang Mapping
knowledge.text:
### RAG-002: Bartender Jargon & Slang Mapping
Dictionary for parsing informal shift reports, WhatsApp logs, and staff text into exact volumetric data.

**Volume Indicators:**
*   **'almost dead'** / **'dead'** / **'אצבע'** = 50ml remaining
*   **'quarter'** / **'רבע'** = 175ml remaining
*   **'half bottle'** / **'חצי בקבוק'** = 350ml remaining
*   **'three quarters'** / **'שלושת רבעי'** = 525ml remaining
*   **'dry'** / **'נגמר'** / **'מת'** = 0ml remaining

**Industry Slang & Operational Terms:**
*   **'ספייר' / 'backup'** = 1 full unopened bottle in the storage room (700ml or 1000ml, depending on brand).
*   **'הרים קנה' / 'harim kaneh'** = Draught line is empty; keg is at 0L and requires replacement.
*   **'מזיע' / 'sweating'** = Keg is running dangerously low, roughly 10% full (approx. 3L left).
*   **'גארניש נקי' / 'clean garnish'** = Citrus (lemon/lime) supply is fully depleted.
*   **'בלי אבנים' / 'no stones'** = Ice machine is empty; triggers an emergency ice delivery protocol.
*   **'פצצה' / 'bomb'** = A sudden, massive rush of orders at a specific station, potentially explaining untracked spillage.
*   **'נפל' / 'dropped'** = Bottle breakage; inventory is at 0ml, must be logged as shrinkage, not sales.

---

knowledge.title: Dynamic Procurement Thresholds & Event Multipliers
knowledge.text:
### RAG-004: Dynamic Procurement Thresholds & Event Multipliers
Automated ordering logic based on baseline stock limits and predictive context scaling.

**Baseline Stock Limits (Safety Stock):**
*   **Jameson:** Always keep at least 3 backup bottles (unopened).
*   **Campari:** Always keep at least 2 backup bottles.
*   **Draught Beer (Carlsberg/Tuborg):** Always keep at least 2 backup kegs in the cold room.
*   **Red Bull:** Always keep at least 3 flats (cases).

**Event Multipliers (Dynamic Forecasting):**
*   **Live Football Broadcast:** Multiply beer keg baseline orders by 1.5x for the preceding delivery window.
*   **Private VIP Event / Birthday Booking:** Multiply premium spirits (e.g., Hendrick's) baseline by 2.0x, and garnish orders by 1.5x.
*   **Mid-Week Holidays / Erev Chag:** Multiply entire baseline order by 1.3x across all categories.

knowledge.title: Spillage, Happy Hour, and VIP Protocols
knowledge.text:
### RAG-005: Spillage, Happy Hour, and VIP Protocols
Rules for reconciling missing physical inventory against unstructured text updates and POS discrepancies.

*   **Spillage & Breakage (פחת):** Staff will text terms like "broken," "dropped," or "spilled" (e.g., "spilled Campari"). The system must immediately deduct the corresponding volume (700ml for a full drop, or the estimated remainder) from the physical count and classify it as operational loss. This accounts for physical depletion with zero corresponding POS revenue.
*   **VIP Comps (פינוקים):** Logged in text as "on the house," "VIP table," or "צ'ייסרים עליי". The system should anticipate a 0 ILS transaction in the POS system linked to this specific inventory deduction. Standard VIP comp threshold is 10 chasers (300ml) or 1 full bottle (700ml). Deductions exceeding this limit require manager approval.
*   **Happy Hour Protocol (1+1):** Active daily between 18:00 and 20:30. During this window, POS sales ring up at 1x revenue, but physical depletion is 2x. If the timestamp of a POS transaction falls within this window, the system must double the deducted volume for draught beers and house spirits to accurately align digital stock with physical reality.

---

knowledge.title: Core Cocktail Recipes & Complex Depletion Metrics
knowledge.text:
### RAG-006: Core Cocktail Recipes & Complex Depletion Metrics
When a specific cocktail is rung up in the POS system, the AI must deduct the exact volumes of multiple ingredients from the digital inventory. Standard garnish is 1 unit unless otherwise noted.

*   **Aperol Spritz:** 90ml Prosecco, 60ml Aperol, 30ml Soda Water, Orange slice garnish. (Note: Prosecco depletion must be tracked per 750ml bottle).
*   **Margarita:** 50ml Patron Silver Tequila, 20ml Triple Sec, 30ml Fresh Lime Juice.
*   **Negroni:** 30ml Campari, 30ml Hendrick's Gin, 30ml Sweet Vermouth.
*   **Mojito:** 50ml White Rum (Bacardi), 25ml Fresh Lime Juice, 15ml Simple Syrup, 8-10 Mint leaves, Top with Soda Water.
*   **Espresso Martini:** 40ml Absolut Vodka, 20ml Coffee Liqueur (Kahlua), 30ml Fresh Espresso, 10ml Simple Syrup.
*   **Gin & Tonic (House):** 50ml House Gin, 150ml Tonic Water (half a standard 330ml can/bottle), Lemon twist.
*   **Long Island Iced Tea:** 15ml Vodka, 15ml Rum, 15ml Gin, 15ml Tequila, 15ml Triple Sec, 25ml Lemon Juice, Top with 50ml Coca-Cola. (High depletion risk alert: deducts from 5 different spirit bottles simultaneously).

knowledge.title: Station Par Levels & Location Mapping
knowledge.text:
### RAG-007: Station Par Levels & Location Mapping
The venue is divided into two operational zones: "Inside Bar" (בר בפנים) and "Outside Bar" (בר בחוץ). If a bartender reports a shortage without specifying the location, the AI must infer the location based on the exclusive inventory mapped below.

**Inside Bar (Main Cocktail & Premium Station):**
*   **Exclusive Stock:** Patron Silver, Sweet Vermouth, Espresso Machine (all coffee-related reports come from here), Premium Whiskeys (Glenfiddich).
*   **Draught Beer:** Carlsberg (50L), Tuborg (50L).
*   **Par Level Requirement:** Minimum 2 bottles of all pouring spirits at the start of shift.

**Outside Bar (High-Volume & Beer Station):**
*   **Exclusive Stock:** Malka Beer (Draught 30L), Weihenstephan (Draught 30L), Aperol (High volume par level), Slushie Machine (מכונת ברד).
*   **Draught Beer:** Carlsberg (30L), Malka (30L), Weihenstephan (30L).
*   **Par Level Requirement:** Focused on speed. Minimum 4 backup kegs in the adjacent outdoor cooler.
*   *Inference Rule:* If a message says "Malka is dead" or "Slushie machine empty", it implicitly originates from the Outside Bar.

---

knowledge.title: Expanded Bartender Jargon (Part 2)
knowledge.text:
### RAG-008: Expanded Bartender Jargon (Part 2)
Further mapping of Hebrew and English nightlife operational slang.

*   **'ברח' / 'Walk-out':** A table left without paying. The physical inventory is depleted, but POS shows an open, unpaid ticket. Must be logged under "Shrinkage - Theft".
*   **'בוטל' / 'Voided':** A drink was poured but returned/refused. Inventory is depleted, POS shows 0 ILS revenue. Must be logged as "Shrinkage - Void".
*   **'פיק' / 'Peak' or 'ראשי / Rush:** Maximum capacity. Expect a 15-20% drop in reporting accuracy during this period. AI should rely heavily on POS data rather than WhatsApp texts during timestamps marked as "Rush".
*   **'פתוח' / 'Open':** An active bottle currently fitted with a pour spout on the speed rack.
*   **'סגור' / 'Closed':** A sealed bottle in reserve.
*   **'שטיחים' / 'Mats':** Rubber bar mats. (Non-inventory context: usually mentioned during opening/closing duties).
*   **'חתול' / 'Cat':** Slang for a specific cleaning task or dealing with spills under the bar. Does not affect alcohol inventory.
*   **'גיבוי' / 'Gibuy':** Same as 'Backup'. Requesting stock from the main storage room.
*   **'דופק' / 'Dofek':** Running smoothly or selling fast (e.g., "הקרלסברג דופק" = Carlsberg is selling rapidly).

---

knowledge.title: Supplier RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) & Credit
knowledge.text:
### RAG-009: Supplier RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) & Credit
Protocols for handling damaged goods, flat kegs, and supplier discrepancies.

*   **Flat Beer Kegs (IBBL):** If a bartender logs "חבית מקציפה" (keg is excessively foaming) or "חבית פגומה" (defective keg) and replaces it before it is empty, the AI must NOT deduct a full 30L/50L as sales. It must log the item as "RMA - Supplier Credit" and draft an alert for the manager to return the keg to IBBL on Tuesday/Friday for a refund.
*   **Broken Delivery (Hakerem):** If a bottle is broken upon delivery (before entering the bar's active stock), it must be logged as "Supplier Breakage". Hakerem requires photographic evidence within 24 hours. The AI should remind the manager to take a photo if "broken delivery" is detected in the chat.
*   **Missing Items from Invoice:** If the delivery invoice says 10 cases of Coca-Cola but the staff logs "קיבלנו רק 9 ארגזי קולה", the AI must flag a discrepancy of -1 case and prepare a credit request text for CBC.

knowledge.title: Weather-Based Predictive Multipliers
knowledge.text:
### RAG-010: Weather-Based Predictive Multipliers
Environmental factors drastically alter consumption patterns. The AI must cross-reference upcoming weather forecasts with the baseline inventory thresholds.

*   **Heatwave (שרב) / Over 32°C:** 
    *   Increase baseline Draught Beer orders by 1.4x.
    *   Increase Aperol and White Wine / Prosecco baseline by 1.5x.
    *   Decrease Heavy Whiskey and Red Wine orders by 0.7x.
    *   *Ice Alert:* Ice machine depletion rate doubles. AI must alert management to order backup commercial ice bags.
*   **Heavy Rain / Winter Storm:**
    *   Decrease Outside Bar inventory baselines by 0.5x (or assume closure of the outside section if severe).
    *   Increase Red Wine and Whiskey baselines by 1.2x for the Inside Bar.
*   **Mild / Spring Weather (20-25°C):** Apply standard 1.0x baseline multipliers.

knowledge.title: Staff Hierarchy & Authorization Levels
knowledge.text:
### RAG-011: Staff Hierarchy & Authorization Levels
The AI must identify the sender's role to determine if an action or report is authorized.

*   **Ahmesh (אחמ"ש - Shift Manager):** High Authority. Can authorize VIP Comps exceeding the standard limit, approve voids, and override par levels. Names currently holding this role: Roei (רועי), Yael (יעל).
*   **Bartender (ברמן/ברמנית):** Standard Authority. Can log inventory, report spillage, and request backups. Cannot authorize voids or large comps. Names: Shir (שיר), Tomer (תומר), Maya (מאיה), Muriel (מוריאל).
*   **Barback (ברבק):** Support Authority. Handles physical movement of inventory. Their WhatsApp reports usually involve moving stock from storage to the bar (e.g., "העליתי ארגז רדבול"). Names: Ido (עידו).
*   *Security/Bouncer (מאבטח):* Not involved in inventory, but may report ejections which disrupt service.

knowledge.title: Consumables & Non-Alcoholic Inventory Tracking
knowledge.text:
### RAG-012: Consumables & Non-Alcoholic Inventory Tracking
The bar cannot operate without dry goods. AI must monitor these based on implicit depletion rates correlated with drink sales.

*   **Napkins (מפיות):** 1 unit depleted per 2 drinks sold. Box contains 500 units. Reorder threshold: 3 boxes.
*   **Straws (קשים):** 1 unit depleted per 1 Long Drink or Cocktail sold (Excludes beer and neat spirits). Box contains 250 units. Reorder threshold: 4 boxes.
*   **Coasters (תחתיות):** 1 unit depleted per Draught Beer sold. Supplied free by IBBL. AI should automatically request more from IBBL rep when beer orders exceed 10 kegs in a week.
*   **CO2 Gas Cylinders (בלוני גז):** Crucial for Draught Beer. 1 standard CO2 cylinder pushes exactly 10 x 50L kegs. AI must track total kegs emptied. Once 8 kegs are depleted since the last CO2 change, AI must alert: "Warning: CO2 replacement needed soon."

---

knowledge.title: POS Reconciliation Matrix
knowledge.text:
### RAG-013: POS Reconciliation Matrix
How the AI should logic check the WhatsApp texts against the End-of-Day (EOD) POS register data.

*   **Scenario A (Perfect Match):** Starting Inventory - POS Sales - Logged Spillage = Ending Inventory.
*   **Scenario B (Unlogged Shrinkage):** Starting Inventory - POS Sales > Ending Inventory (and no spillage was reported in WhatsApp). *Action:* AI flags discrepancy to manager, calculating exact missing volume and retail value loss.
*   **Scenario C (Over-pouring):** Drink count in POS matches expected sales, but physical alcohol depleted faster than standard recipes dictate (e.g., 20 Margaritas sold, but 1.5L of Tequila is missing instead of 1.0L). *Action:* AI flags consistent over-pouring on specific shifts.
*   **Scenario D (Phantom Stock):** Ending Inventory > (Starting Inventory - POS Sales). *Action:* AI flags a likely miscount by the bartender during closing, or an undocumented delivery that arrived mid-shift.

---

knowledge.title: Maintenance & Emergency Protocols
knowledge.text:
### RAG-014: Maintenance & Emergency Protocols
System-level understanding of physical bar infrastructure failures.

*   **"המקרר נפל" / Fridge Failure:** If reported, all perishable garnishes and dairy (if applicable) must be marked as 100% loss within 4 hours. White wine and beer sales will halt.
*   **"אין מים" / Water Cut:** Dishwasher cannot operate. Glassware will run out in approximately 45 minutes during a rush.
*   **"הקופה קרסה" / POS Crash:** Staff will switch to manual ticketing. AI must expect a massive data gap in digital sales and rely 100% on WhatsApp text reports for inventory depletion during the crash window.
